issues.title: Epic: Backend Core And Persistence
issues.body:
## Goal
Create the FastAPI control plane and durable domain state for ContentFactory.

## Scope
Config, health, DB session, migrations, SQLAlchemy/Pydantic models, CRUD boundaries for Campaign, Character, Episode, Scene, VoiceLine, TextBeat, Asset, Export.

## Non-Goals
No real ComfyUI render execution in this epic.

## Acceptance Criteria
- API starts locally.
- Core models persist in dev DB.
- CRUD endpoints are covered by tests.
- Secrets remain outside DB.

issues.title: Epic: Job Queue And Render State
issues.body:
## Goal
Introduce worker-backed RenderJob and RenderStep execution with retry/cancel semantics.

## Scope
Queue setup, worker process, step state machine, structured step logs, retry policy, cancellation boundary.

## Acceptance Criteria
- RenderJob can be created and enqueued.
- Worker updates step state.
- Failed retryable steps can be retried without losing artifacts.

issues.title: Epic: Narrative Overlay And Export Policy
issues.body:
## Goal
Make burned-in narrative text a first-class validated export requirement.

## Scope
TextBeat validation, safe-area policy, ffmpeg overlay provider, export metadata, no_text_experiment escape hatch.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Standard TikTok export fails without text starting by 0.3s.
- no_text_experiment is explicit and stored.
- Final MP4 has burned-in text metadata tracked.

issues.title: Epic: Test Harness And Delivery Workflow
issues.body:
## Goal
Keep the project reviewable and safe through tests, CI, and disciplined git workflow.

## Scope
pytest harness, fixtures, unit tests, GitHub issue/PR conventions, CI skeleton, optional nightly integration tests.

- CI runs lint/tests for backend and frontend skeleton.
- Issues and PRs map to approved batches.

issues.title: Epic: Factory Agent Orchestrator
issues.body:
## Goal
Build an in-product Factory Agent that operates the ContentFactory through controlled backend tools, not direct frontend shell access.

## Scope
Agent sessions, message persistence, SSE events, provider-agnostic LLM adapter, typed tool registry, context builder, prompt/profile registry, approvals, audit logs, Copilot UI, read-only production tools, caption pack generation, and controlled render job launch.

## Non-Goals
No autonomous TikTok posting, destructive file operations, unapproved paid API calls, unrestricted shell execution, realtime voice agent, or multi-agent autopilot in this epic.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Operator can chat with the Factory Agent inside the product UI.
- Agent answers with grounded artifact, timestamp, metric, and tool-result references.
- Read-only tools can inspect artifacts/stats without approval.
- Expensive or external-cost actions require explicit approval.
- Approved render jobs are created through backend APIs and remain auditable.
- Provider credentials never leave the backend.
- Prompt/profile/context decisions are versioned and testable.

issues.title: Batch: Agent Chat Shell And Session API
issues.body:
## Goal
Create the first reviewable Factory Agent vertical slice: persistent sessions, messages, streaming events, and a Copilot panel shell.

## Tasks
- Add agent session/message schemas, models, repositories, and API endpoints.
- Add POST /api/v1/agent/sessions and POST /api/v1/agent/sessions/{id}/messages.
- Add GET /api/v1/agent/sessions/{id}/events using SSE for MVP streaming.
- Add a persistent right-side Copilot panel to the workspace UI.
- Add a basic context builder that includes selected campaign/episode/job/artifact references.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A user can create or resume an agent session.
- Assistant text responses stream to the UI.
- Message and event history survives API object recreation in tests.
- No tool execution or provider secret is exposed to the frontend.

## Test Plan
- API tests for create session, post message, stream event, and resume session.
- Frontend typecheck/build for the Copilot shell.

issues.title: Batch: LLM Provider And Prompt Contracts
issues.body:
## Goal
Introduce provider-agnostic LLM and prompt/profile contracts before wiring production tools.

## Tasks
- Add internal LLMProvider interface with createResponse, streamResponse, and capability flags.
- Add settings for LLM_PROVIDER, LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_API_KEY, LLM_MODEL, LLM_REASONING_MODEL, LLM_VISION_MODEL, timeout, token budget, tool support, vision support, and structured-output support.
- Add OpenAI-compatible adapter scaffolding for openai, azure_openai, gemini_compat, and custom_openai_compat modes.
- Add prompt registry contract with versioned system prompts and agent profiles.
- Implement fallback modes: native tool calling, structured JSON proposals, and advisor-only.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Provider selection is configurable without frontend secrets.
- Runtime can report provider capabilities.
- Weak tool-support providers downgrade safely to structured proposals or advisor mode.
- Prompt assembly order is deterministic and covered by tests.

## Test Plan
- Unit tests for settings parsing, capability fallback, prompt assembly, and provider timeout/error normalization.

issues.title: Batch: Typed Agent Tool Registry And Read-Only Tools
issues.body:
## Goal
Expose safe, typed backend tools so the agent can inspect factory state without shell access.

## Tasks
- Add a deny-by-default tool registry with typed input/output schemas, safety class, timeout, cost hint, and audit metadata.
- Implement MVP read-only tools: list_artifacts, inspect_video, extract_keyframes, analyze_tiktok_stats, and compare_variants.
- Normalize tool results into artifact refs, timestamps, metrics, warnings, and structured errors.
- Persist tool calls, tool results, and context snapshots for replay.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Unknown tools are rejected before execution.
- Invalid tool inputs return schema errors.
- Read-only tools run without approval and cannot mutate core factory state.
- Agent responses can reference concrete artifact IDs, paths, timestamps, and metrics from tool results.

## Test Plan
- Unit tests for registry allowlist, schema validation, structured errors, and each read-only tool with fixtures.

issues.title: Batch: Approval Gates And Controlled Job Launch
issues.body:
## Goal
Let the Factory Agent propose expensive or external-cost actions while keeping execution under explicit user approval.

## Tasks
- Add safety classes read_only, cheap_write, expensive_job, external_api_cost, and destructive.
- Add agent_approvals persistence and approve/reject endpoints.
- Add approval cards in the Copilot UI with tool name, estimated cost, duration, input spec, and output location.
- Wire create_render_job to the existing render queue only after approval.
- Emit SSE events for approval.required, approval.resolved, tool.started, tool.result, error, and done.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Expensive job tools cannot execute without an approved approval_id.
- Rejected approvals leave an audit trail and do not enqueue work.
- Approved render jobs appear in the existing job monitor.
- Destructive tools are unavailable in MVP.

## Test Plan
- API tests for pending, approved, rejected, expired, and duplicate approval decisions.
- UI build/typecheck for approval card states.
- Queue integration test for approved create_render_job.

issues.title: Batch: Caption Pack And Production Recommendations
issues.body:
## Goal
Give the Factory Agent a shippable production-assistant workflow for captions, hashtags, first comments, and next-edit recommendations.

## Tasks
- Implement prepare_caption_pack with caption, hashtags, first comment, strategy note, and artifact refs.
- Add recommendation cards grounded in artifacts, TikTok metrics, first-2-second retention heuristics, and text-beat policy.
- Store variant history and experiment notes as agent memory candidates.
- Add Copilot UI cards for caption pack, recommendation, and proposed edit actions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Agent can produce a posting pack for a selected artifact without exposing secrets or private paths.
- Recommendations include reason, evidence, and one concrete next action.
- Memory writes are curated and auditable, not raw chat dumps.
- Output is linked to artifact/variant context.

## Test Plan
- Deterministic tests for caption pack schema and recommendation fixtures.
- UI build/typecheck for recommendation and caption cards.

issues.title: Batch: Agent Contract Evals And Hardening
issues.body:
## Goal
Make the Factory Agent reviewable and safe through replayable contracts, eval fixtures, and operational guardrails.

## Tasks
- Add saved conversation and artifact fixtures for retention diagnosis, variant comparison, caption pack, and approval-required render requests.
- Add regression tests for no ungrounded file/render/stat claims.
- Add structured logging with session_id, message_id, provider, model, tool name, latency, and token/cost metadata.
- Add idempotency keys for side-effect tools and bounded retry/timeout policy.
- Document degraded modes for missing analytics, unavailable provider, and interrupted SSE streams.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Contract evals run locally without GPU, TikTok, or paid API calls.
- Tool and provider failures return structured, user-visible errors.
- Side-effect tools are idempotent or explicitly rejected on duplicate request.
- Code review has replay artifacts for core agent flows.

## Test Plan
- Backend unit tests and fixture-based eval tests.
- Manual local smoke test for interrupted/reconnected SSE stream.
